ayahOccurrences.text: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَهْجَعُونَ is in the derivative form: يَهْجَعُ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
هـ/ج/ع   h–j–ʿ part of the night; to sleep at night, to lie down peacefully at night; slumber; to abate; foolish person. Of this root, يَهْجَعُون yahjaʿūn occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَهْجَعُ yahjaʿ [imperf. of v. intrans.] to sleep at night without any concerns

(51:17) كَانُوا قَلِيلاً مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ little of the night would they [lie down] to sleep unconcerned.
